methods.name: multi-hot encoding
methods.description: Formulates ordinal classification with K classes as K-1 independent binary classifications where each class is a superset of the previous.

methods.name: data augmentation
methods.description: Applied random horizontal and vertical flipping, random rotation of 10 degrees, and small random brightness and contrast jittering.

methods.name: 5-fold cross-validation
methods.description: Used to determine the stopping iteration for training.

methods.name: ResNet34 one-hot
methods.description: Standard approach for categorical classification using ResNet-34 backbone, where each class is treated independently and masking levels are predicted using softmax and cross-entropy loss to predict one-hot encodings.

methods.name: ResNet34 multi-hot
methods.description: Baseline model using ResNet-34 backbone that accounts for the ordinal relation between masking levels using multi-hot encodings.

methods.name: Grouping of masking levels
methods.description: Considers the two lowest masking levels (1 and 2) together as low-masking levels, and the two highest ones (7 and 8) as high-masking levels based on expert feedback.

methods.name: Identification of interval and large invasive cancers
methods.description: A secondary task measuring the correlation between predicted masking estimates and certain cancers (interval cancers and large invasive cancers) without explicit training for these tasks.

methods.name: ordinal classification
methods.description: modeling the median expert opinion of masking potential level in the range [1-8]

methods.name: Odds Ratio computation
methods.description: Model predictions are divided into quartiles gi (i in {1,2,3,4}), odds of interval cancer are computed as Oi = ICi / ~ICi, and odds ratios are computed relative to the first quartile as ORi = Oi / O1.

methods.name: Continuous score conversion
methods.description: Converts discrete masking predictions to continuous values by computing the weighted average of probabilities that an input belongs to each masking level.
